title: "Class3/2"
format: html
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data(midwest)
```

```{r}
midwest <- midwest
```

```{r}
Q1_Column<- midwest |>
  select(county, state, percprof, poppovertyknown, inmetro) |>
  arrange(poppovertyknown, desc(percprof)) |>
  filter(inmetro == 0 & percprof < 5) 
```

```{r}
midwest|>
  mutate(popProf= percprof/100 * poptotal) |>
  select(county, state, popProf)
```

```{r}
midwest |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarize(
    county= n(),
    poptotal= n(),
    poppovertyknown= median(poppovertyknown),
    inmetro= mean(inmetro)
    )
```
